failure_modes.name: nozzle_pump_clog
failure_modes.symptoms: uneven spray pattern; reduced flow rate; localized under-dose streak on crop; pump pressure-low alarm
failure_modes.mitigation: flush lines with clean water after every sortie; install inline strainer; replace nozzles every ~50h; use recommended dilution

failure_modes.name: battery_fast_charge_fade
failure_modes.symptoms: reduced flight time; cell-imbalance warning; faster temp rise during fast charge; premature low-battery RTH
failure_modes.mitigation: limit fast-charge fraction of cycles; weekly balance charge; store at ~50% SOC; retire pack below 80% capacity

failure_modes.name: chemical_corrosion
failure_modes.symptoms: white oxide deposits on frame; sticky boom hinges; corroded screw heads; sensor-bracket loosening
failure_modes.mitigation: rinse airframe after herbicide/fertilizer use; anti-corrosion spray on joints; monthly bracket torque check

failure_modes.name: radar_misses_on_wires
failure_modes.symptoms: power/fence wire absent from obstacle map; close-call near lines; radar blind at grazing incidence; no avoidance trigger
failure_modes.mitigation: manual wire survey before autonomous mapping; fuse vision+radar; slow transit near known lines; operator spotter

failure_modes.name: esc_overtemp
failure_modes.symptoms: ESC temperature warning; reduced thrust on hot motor; auto-land triggered; acrid smell
failure_modes.mitigation: derate in high-ambient temps; clean motor/ESC cooling fins; firmware current limit; pre-flight motor-temp check

failure_modes.name: rtk_drift
failure_modes.symptoms: position drift >10cm; NTRIP fix lost/float; zig-zag flight path; swath overlap misalignment
failure_modes.mitigation: verify base-station link health; redundant NTRIP source; reposition mast antenna; re-survey when fix floats
